text: Cyber Sand（DSH 插件，网页客户端）：为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加赛博城市夜景背景和蓝青色主题。它通过浏览器客户端入口注册到 theme 服务，在页面铺设固定背景，并将配色作为主题 token 覆盖应用。功能包括半透明深海军蓝面板、城市背景、青蓝强调色，以及文字、边框、按钮、滚动条和 Markdown 等界面 token 的明暗配色。适合希望为 DSH 网页端更换沉浸式赛博风格的用户。安装命令为 dsh plugin --profile web add；代码没有声明额外密钥或服务配置。

Cyber Sand is a DSH web theme with a cyber-city background and blue-cyan palette. Its browser entry registers with the theme service, adds a fixed background, and overrides light and dark tokens for panels, text, buttons, borders, scrollbars, and Markdown. No extra keys are declared.
想给 DSH 网页界面换成赛博城市夜景风格。
能不能把网页端的主题配色改成深蓝面板和青蓝色强调？
Give my DSH web interface a cyber-city background and matching theme colors.
Cyber Sand 的功能「赛博城市网页主题」：在 DSH 网页端铺设固定城市夜景背景，并通过 theme 服务应用深色基底和蓝青色明暗配色。插件加载时自动覆盖面板、文字、按钮、边框、滚动条与 Markdown 颜色。

@anywhere-labs/dsh-client-theme-cyber README · dsh-client-theme-cyber：**Cyber Sand** — a dark cyber-city theme for DeepSeek Harness Web.

赛博沙漠（Cyber Sand）主题：以深海军蓝半透明面板承载赛博城市夜景背景，青色（全息立方体辉光）作为品牌与焦点色，为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端/网页端提供沉浸式暗色主题。

> Theme plugin (client bundle, `dsh.client.platform: "web"`) for DeepSeek Harness.
> It applies a token palette via `theme.overrideTokens` and paints the uploaded
> cyber-city artwork as a fixed full-viewport background behind the app panels.

@anywhere-labs/dsh-client-theme-cyber README · Features：- Dark navy glass panels (semi-transparent, so the city glows through).
- The uploaded cyber-city image as a fixed `body::before` background layer.
- Cyan holographic-cube glow as the brand/accent color (`#2ea8ff` dark / `#1d7fe0` light).
- ~30 `--dsw-alias-*` tokens overridden (backgrounds, labels, borders, states, buttons, scrollbars, markdown, sidebar), stacking as a persistent override layer that survives reconnect and theme preference sync.
- Forces the built-in dark base (`theme.setTheme("dark")`), as required so the theme stays active across `adopt()`.

@anywhere-labs/dsh-client-theme-cyber README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add <this-package-or-repo>
```

After install, the theme activates immediately (no restart needed); it will also
appear in the market's Themes page once published to the catalog.
@anywhere-labs/dsh-client-theme-cyber README · How it works：`lib/client.js` (browser half) registers through `window.__ModuleLoader__` and exports:
@anywhere-labs/dsh-client-theme-cyber README · How it works：`lib/index.js` (host half) is a stub: everything lives in the browser bundle.

@anywhere-labs/dsh-client-theme-cyber README · Layout：```
lib/index.js        host half (stub)
lib/client.js       built browser half (data-URI background embedded)
client.template.js  source template (build via `node build.mjs`)
assets/             source images (city / cube), data-URI text + info

@anywhere-labs/dsh-client-theme-cyber README · Building：```sh
node build.mjs      # replaces __CITY_BG__ in client.template.js -> lib/client.js
node regen-city.mjs # re-derives assets/city.webp.txt (brightened JPEG) from the source image
```

@anywhere-labs/dsh-client-theme-cyber README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-client-theme-cyber
```

Removing the theme restores the default DSH dark palette and no longer injects the
background layer (uninstall fully reverts).
